analysis.investment_thesis: Srigee DLM is a recently-listed micro-cap (BSE code 544399, ₹38 Cr market cap) with essentially no earning power — an ROE of 0.30% means the business is producing almost nothing on its capital base. The seemingly low P/E of 9.46 is illusory: when earnings are negligible, a low multiple offers no margin of safety.
key_strengths: P/E of 9.46 is nominally below my 15x threshold
Promoter holding of 45.23% provides some skin in the game
Asset-backed business (plastic manufacturing) with tangible operations
key_risks: ROE of 0.30% signals virtually no earning power — disqualifying
Recent IPO/listing — no multi-year earnings track record I require
Micro-cap at ₹38 Cr with 2.25% FII and 0% DII — illiquid and uninstitutional
red_flags: 0.30% ROE is indistinguishable from capital destruction
No demonstrated 3-5 year earnings history as a listed entity
IPO/SME-style listing — pricing favors the seller, not the investor
analysis.detailed_analysis:
From my perspective, the cardinal test is proven, sustained earning power — and Srigee DLM fails it outright. An ROE of 0.30% means shareholders' capital is earning roughly what a zero-interest current account earns; this is not a business producing value, it is capital sitting idle. The optically attractive P/E of 9.46 is a statistical artifact of tiny earnings on a small equity base. I would need to see Book Value, Current Ratio, Debt/Equity, and at least five years of post-listing earnings before the Graham Number could even be computed meaningfully — and none of that evidence is on offer.

This is precisely the sort of situation I warned about in The Intelligent Investor: a recently-listed small enterprise, promoted into public markets, where the seller and underwriters possess information the buyer does not. At ₹38 Cr market cap with negligible institutional ownership (2.25% FII, 0% DII), Mr. Market here is thinly populated and the price discovery is unreliable. There is no margin of safety, no dividend record, and no demonstrated earning power. AVOID.
